quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Osaka Cement semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half April-September 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 105,772 million (-JPY 2,841 million year on year), operating income JPY 4,119 million (prior-year half JPY 2,280 million), ordinary income JPY 4,233 million (+JPY 2,109 million), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 5,590 million (+JPY 4,647 million). By segment: Cement JPY 75,190 million (-3.1%) with operating income JPY 37 million (an improvement of JPY 1,702 million on domestic price hikes); Mineral Products JPY 8,648 million (-1.6%); Construction Materials JPY 10,556 million (-11.0%); Optoelectronics net sales JPY 1,276 million (+11.0%) on higher optoelectronic equipment volume, with an operating loss of JPY 69 million, an improvement of JPY 181 million on cost reductions in optical communications components; New Materials JPY 8,337 million (+13.8%) and operating income JPY 1,425 million (+45.3%) on the product mix of electronic materials for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 1,821 million. Domestic cement demand fell 6.1% to 15,354 thousand tonnes.
